anomalies.observed: On the SKW92A sheet, a GND power symbol is wired to a junction at the top of the module. That junction sits on the same vertical wire that carries the NET0021 label. NET0021 is the EPD connector signal on J5 pin 14. The drawing therefore appears to tie an EPD signal directly to ground.
anomalies.expected: The EPD signal net NET0021 should connect only to its SKW92A GPIO pin and to J5 pin 14, with no path to GND. The specification gives no ground connection on this signal.

evidence.quote: Page 2 (SkylabModule): GND symbol wired to junction on the vertical wire carrying NET0021 label, above SKW92A pins 13-15
J1.14 (SDA) ↔ SPI_MOSI ↔ U5.12; J1.9 (BUSY_N) ↔ EINK_DISPLAY_BUSY ↔ U5.43. The spec assigns no ground connection to the EPD signal lines.

anomalies.impact: If the junction is a real connection, the EPD data or control line would be clamped to ground, so the display interface would fail to communicate and the module GPIO could be damaged.
